◆ 90 MILLION USERS ◆

Yuka is a free mobile app that allows you to scan the barcodes of food and personal care products and instantly see their impact on your health. A rating and detailed information help you understand the analysis of each product.

When a product has a negative impact on your health, Yuka also recommends similar but healthier alternative products.

◆ A 100% INDEPENDENT PROJECT ◆

Yuka is a 100% independent project : product reviews and recommendations of healthier alternatives are done in an objective way. No brand or manufacturer can influence them in one way or another. Furthermore, there is no in-app advertising. You can access detailed information on our business model on our website (www.yuka.io).

◆ 6 MILLION REFERENCED PRODUCTS ◆

Yuka established a database that contains 4 million food products and 2 million cosmetic products.

Each food product is evaluated according to 3 objective criteria: nutritional quality, presence of additives and organic aspect of the product.

The method to analyse cosmetic products is based on the analysis of all the ingredients of the product. Each ingredient is assigned a risk level according to the latest scientific data.

---
Terms of use: https://yuka-app.helpdocs.io/l/en/article/2a12869y56

Bobby Approved is a free food scanner app that instantly shows if a food product is good for your health or not. Learn how to buy the best quality products from the grocery store with the Bobby Approved app. Just point your camera, scan the barcode, and find out if that box of pasta, loaf of bread, or box of cereal is made with best-in-class ingredients, or if you should put it back.

The bad ingredients are highlighted in red, and by tapping on them you can learn why. Bobby has spend years researching ingredients in products and their potential health impact and has created a list of over 100 harmful ingredients, which is available to explore no the app.

If you are one of the 12+ million people who follow Bobby @flavcity, you know he has an unwavering dedication to helping people put the best quality foods in their body. For years Bobby has been making videos at the most popular grocery stores in the country and now with this free app you can take the guesswork out of shopping. It’s like shopping alongside Bobby!


Using the food scanner app is super easy:
- Scan any food barcode to see if a product is Bobby approved or not, and why. The harmful ingredients are highlighted in red.
- Tap on each ingredient to understand its health impact.
- Search products, ingredients, or browse products by store.
- If a product is not Bobby Approved, the app will give you healthy alternatives.

Ingredients we flag:
Bobby has flagged over 100 ingredients in our database as potentially harmful. All of these flagged ingredients are backed by scientific studies and include natural and artificial flavors, fake sugars, food dyes, chemical additives, inflammatory seed oils, preservatives and more. By identifying these additives in your food, you can shop for yourself and family with confidence. Our products and ingredients library are continuously updated with new products and data.

results.releaseNotes:
Clearer results and more additive names recognized.

• Sugars, salt, fats and allergens now appear by name, without Yuko's internal codes.
• More additive names are recognized on labels, including US color names such as Yellow 5 and Blue 1, and glaze names such as confectioner's glaze (shellac, E904).
• Label matching is more accurate, with fewer mix-ups between similar names.
• Two new health conditions: gout and insulin resistance, with their sources.
• New Updates area: see Yuko's in-app events and, if you like, turn on Events in Settings to get a notification when a new one starts.
• History now keeps up to 50 label scans instead of 10, each with its photo.
• Notification fixes: if you've already purchased, you no longer get offer reminders.

Thanks for scanning with Yuko!
results.description:
Scan a barcode or the ingredients label and see what is really inside the food you are about to buy.

WHAT YOU GET FROM ONE SCAN

● PLAIN-LANGUAGE VERDICT
Yuko reads the ingredients and tells you what stands out: higher-risk additives, allergens listed on the pack, and nutrient levels that are high. When there is not enough information to judge, Yuko says that instead of pretending.

● ADDITIVE ENCYCLOPAEDIA
340+ E-numbers and other additives, each with a risk level and a plain explanation of what it is and what it does. Risk levels are based on EFSA, WHO, FAO and Turkish Food Codex assessments, and scan results link to the sources.

● THE FULL PRODUCT RECORD
Nutri-Score, NOVA processing group and Green-Score, each with the breakdown that produced it. Full nutrition table per 100 g or per serving, with high/medium/low levels for fat, saturated fat, sugars and salt. Ingredients with allergens highlighted. Labels and certifications. Packaging and recycling. Origins, countries and stores. Product photos.

● PERSONAL AND FAMILY PROFILES
Tell Yuko about allergies and health conditions, for yourself and for the people you shop for, and scans are checked against every profile.

● SCAN HISTORY
Your scans are saved, so you can compare products later, offline.

● WORKS ON THE LABEL, NOT JUST THE BARCODE
If a product is not in the database, point the camera at the ingredients list and Yuko reads it directly.

WHO IT IS FOR
Parents reading labels for their children, people managing allergies or a specific diet, anyone who wants to know what an unpronounceable ingredient actually is.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Scan the barcode, or the ingredients list
2. Read the verdict and the detail behind it
3. Tap any additive to learn what it is

IMPORTANT
Yuko is an information tool, not medical advice. Ingredient and allergen data comes from a community database and can be incomplete or out of date, so always check the pack itself, especially for allergies.

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
The first 3 scans are free. Yuko Pro unlocks unlimited scanning; every other feature is included at no extra cost.
• Weekly: billed every week, with a 3-day free trial
• Yearly: billed every year
• Lifetime: one-time purchase
Prices are shown in your local currency in the app before you buy. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel subscriptions in your Apple Account settings.

Barcode product data, photos and scores are provided by Open Food Facts contributors and are available under the Open Database License (ODbL). openfoodfacts.org

results.description:
OnSkin is your science-backed ingredient checker and product scanner for skincare, makeup, hair care, and household products—trusted by over 8 million users.

Not sure what's actually in the products you use every day? OnSkin decodes ingredient labels, so you know which products are made with clean ingredients—whether you're checking what you already own or scanning before you buy. It's backed by a curated database of 2 million products, from viral K-beauty finds to everyday drugstore staples.

INGREDIENT CHECKER
Wondering what’s inside that face cream? Scan it and find out. OnSkin is your cosmetic checker for skincare, makeup, hair care, and more, giving you a clear verdict—Excellent, Good, Not Great, or Bad—plus plain-language notes on every ingredient. If it scores low, OnSkin suggests safer alternatives.

SKINCARE FINDER
Overwhelmed by choice in the skincare aisle? Answer a short questionnaire about your skin type and goals—think moisturizing, calming, or anti-acne—and OnSkin curates matching beauty products, from face cleansers to sunscreen. Less guessing in the store.

SKINCARE ROUTINE
Want a routine that actually fits your skin? Complete your Skin Profile, and OnSkin builds a personalized morning and evening skincare routine around your skin type and goals, so every step makes sense.

SHELF SCAN
Tired of scanning products one at a time? Shelf Scan reads your entire bathroom cabinet in one go and delivers safety and quality scores on the spot.

SKIN MATCH
Wondering if a product's right for you? OnSkin skips generic "clean beauty" labels and checks it against your skin type, sensitivities, concerns, and goals—then gives you a clear verdict on whether the product is a match.

ONSKIN COMMUNITY
Curious how other people handle the same skin or hair concerns? Join the OnSkin Community to swap tips, ask questions, and get inspired by real skincare journeys.

HAIR LAB
Not sure if your shampoo or conditioner suits your hair type? OnSkin goes beyond the skincare scanner, checking any hair product against your hair type and goals. Your Hair Match score shows how well it fits, so you can build a hair care routine that works for you.

AI SKIN HELPER
Need quick advice on your skin type or the latest beauty trend? Ask your own question or pick a popular one and get personalized guidance from the AI Skin Helper in seconds.

MORE TO EXPLORE
Check your local UV Index, browse trending Popular Scans, or test your instincts with the daily Guess the Score game.

WHY TRUST ONSKIN
–  Independent safety ratings for skincare, hair care, makeup, and household products—no brand deals, no sponsored reviews.
–  Grounded in toxicology and dermatology research, with 15,000+ ingredients analyzed for safety, quality, and toxicity.
–  Recommendations and scoring criteria reviewed by our in-house team of certified dermatologists.
–  No vague "non-toxic" claims—just clear, honest ingredient explanations.
–  Proud partner of the Skin Cancer Foundation.

RECOGNITION
Featured in Forbes, CNN, Vogue, and The Independent. Double winner of a 2024 Webby Award and a New York Product Design Award.

FAQ
Q: Is OnSkin good for acne-prone skin?
A: Yes—Skin Match flags acne-safe products based on your skin profile.
Q: What if a product isn't in the database yet?
A: Request an On-Demand Analysis and get its safety score in just a few hours.
Q: Can I check household and cleaning products too?
A: Yes—OnSkin analyzes household and cleaning products with the same expert-reviewed safety ratings.

Download OnSkin—your all-in-one ingredient checker and product scanner for skincare, makeup, hair care, and household essentials—and stop guessing what’s in your products.

PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION
–  You can subscribe to get unlimited access to certain app features.
–  Subscriptions are billed automatically based on the selected subscription plan.
